nodes.label: Next-Latent Prediction Transformers
nodes.rationale: Introduces NextLat training objective that extends next-token prediction with self-supervised latent-space predictions to learn compact world models and belief states in transformers

nodes.label: Belief States
nodes.rationale: Compressed representations of history that are sufficient statistics for predicting future observations; key property for planning and generalization in sequence models

nodes.label: World Models
nodes.rationale: Internal predictive models of how the world works; enable agents to reason about future states and plan actions

nodes.label: Latent Dynamics Modeling
nodes.rationale: Learning transition functions that model how latent representations evolve over sequences; enables recursive multi-step lookahead and variable-length speculative decoding

nodes.label: Next-Latent Prediction (NextLat)
nodes.rationale: Training objective that extends next-token prediction with self-supervised latent-space predictions to learn compact world models and belief states in transformers

nodes.label: Manhattan Taxi Rides Benchmark
nodes.rationale: World modeling benchmark with interpretable true world model (city street map) to evaluate coherence of learned internal representations

nodes.label: Countdown Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Mathematical reasoning task requiring combinatorial search to combine numbers with arithmetic operations to reach target; tests lookahead planning capability

nodes.label: Path-Star Graph Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Minimal lookahead planning task designed to reveal myopic behavior of next-token prediction models and test generalization to OOD graph topologies

nodes.label: TinyStories Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Long-horizon planning benchmark with synthetic short stories requiring coherent narrative generation and maintenance of persistent entities

nodes.label: Next-Latent Prediction (NextLat)
nodes.rationale: Framework that augments next-token training with self-supervised latent-space prediction to enable transformers to learn belief-state representations

nodes.label: Belief State Learning
nodes.rationale: Theoretical foundation showing that NextLat objective naturally induces pressure to form concise latent summaries of past information sufficient to predict future

nodes.label: Latent Dynamics Model (pψ)
nodes.rationale: RNN-like component trained via one-step and multi-step latent prediction to learn temporally consistent representations without sequential computation during training

nodes.label: Recurrent Inductive Bias
nodes.rationale: NextLat introduces recurrent-like dynamics implicitly through latent transition prediction without modifying transformer architecture

nodes.label: A5 Word Problem Experiment
nodes.rationale: Demonstrates that co-trained RNN generalizes beyond transformer's expressivity limits despite being trained entirely in parallel on NC1-complete task

nodes.label: Speculative Decoding Application
nodes.rationale: NextLat enables variable-length speculative decoding for inference speedup by using latent dynamics model as draft generator

nodes.label: Next-Token Loss (L_next)
nodes.rationale: Standard cross-entropy loss for next-token prediction in NextLat framework

nodes.label: Next-Hidden Loss (L_next-h)
nodes.rationale: Smooth L1 loss for latent state regression, required for belief-state convergence

nodes.label: KL Distillation Loss (L_KL)
nodes.rationale: Self-distillation loss matching predicted token distribution to model's own softmax distribution under target hidden state

nodes.label: Theorem 3.2: Belief State Convergence
nodes.rationale: Theoretical result showing convergence of belief-state learning in NextLat is irrespective of prediction horizon d

edges.rationale: Both methods learn to coordinate and compose multiple components (latent dynamics vs LLMs) to improve reasoning and task performance

hyperedges.label: Belief State and Coordination Integration
hyperedges.rationale: Belief states in NextLat and multi-turn coordination in Conductor/TRINITY both maintain and refine contextual understanding across sequential steps
